title: MEMIG: Self-evolving Memory Construction for Antibody Optimization
title_zh: MEMIG：用于抗体优化的自进化记忆构建

paragraphs.en: 提出可索引、量化、结构化的记忆框架MEMIG，提升自进化智能体在抗体优化任务中的表现。 Memory has become central to self-evolving LLM agents, which store and retrieve experience from past rollouts to guide future decisions. Existing systems represent this experience as free-form natural language and maintain it by rewriting, which fits tasks whose experience is narratable. However, in scientific discovery and optimization, experience is often a quantity measured by an oracle under a specific context. Rewriting it as text leaves no index for where a record should be, replaces a measurement with a description, and cannot express how interventions interact. To address this, we argue that agent memory for biomolecule optimization should instead be indexable, quantitative, and structured, and we introduce MEMIG. This memory construction framework realizes these three properties. In detail, MEMIG addresses each insight with a domain-grounded identifier and accumulates the quantitative effect measured by a property oracle, so that updates remain local and retrieval becomes an exact lookup. Next, MEMIG connects insights whose interventions are applied together and measures their epistasis by decomposing each evaluated set. Our results show that MEMIG improves performance in most settings across in silico antibody optimization tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 提出了可索引、量化、结构化的记忆框架MEMIG，提升自进化智能体在抗体优化任务中的表现。记忆已成为自进化LLM智能体的核心，它们存储并检索过去rollout的经验，以指导未来的决策。 现有系统将这种经验表示为自由格式的自然语言，并通过重写来维护它，这适用于经验可以被叙述的任务。 然而，在科学发现和优化中，经验往往是在特定情境下由oracle测得的一个量值。 将其改写为文本，既无法为记录应该存放的位置留下索引，又用描述替代了测量，还不能表达干预之间如何相互作用。 为解决这一问题，我们主张用于生物分子优化的智能体记忆应当是可索引、量化且结构化的，并据此提出了MEMIG。 这一记忆构建框架实现了上述三个特性。 具体而言，MEMIG用一个基于领域的标识符对应每条洞见，并累积由性质oracle测得的量化效应，使更新保持局部化，检索成为精确查找。 接着，MEMIG将干预被同时应用的洞见连接起来，并通过分解每个被评估的集合来度量它们之间的上位性。 我们的结果表明，在计算机模拟抗体优化任务的大多数设置中，MEMIG都提升了性能。
